parties: Manoj Kumar Daga; Norben Tea & Exports Limited
headline: Norben Tea & Exports Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Manoj Kumar Daga has filed a substantial acquisition of shares disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4), signalling a material change in shareholding or control event at Norben Tea & Exports Limited.
implication: A Regulation 31(4) disclosure triggers ongoing public disclosure obligations under the Takeover Code; counsel must audit whether a full Section 4 mandatory offer requirement is triggered based on the aggregate shareholding percentage and prior holdings of the acquirer.
detail: Manoj Kumar Daga submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is filed when a person or group crosses specified threshold shareholdings (typically 25%, 35%, or 55%) or is about to do so. The exact shareholding percentage and consideration amount are not disclosed in the Bar & Bench abstract; the full filing on NSE would contain the detailed structure, timing of acquisition, and any conditions precedent.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure requirement when threshold shareholding is crossed; prescribes timeline (2 trading days), content (shareholding, sources of funds, acquirer details) and exemptions.
Mandatory open offer trigger: if acquirer(s) cross 25% or acquire 5% or more in 12 months raising aggregate to 25%+, an offer to all shareholders is mandatory.

framework.ref: SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011, Regulation 3(2) & Schedule I
framework.note: Definition of 'acquirer', 'concert party' and 'shareholder', and deemed acquisition rules for related party structures.
Director nomination and board refresh obligations post-control change; if Daga obtains board representation, appointment mechanics and disclosure apply.
Exchange-level continuous disclosure, prior intimation, and announcement obligations; super-majority shareholder approvals for related-party contracts.
Deemed public company threshold; if shareholding concentration changes, classification and compliance load may shift.

framework.ref: Prevention of Fraudulent and Unfair Trade Practices Regulations (PFUTP), 2015
framework.note: Insider trading compliance during acquisition window; standstill and disclosure periods defined.

conditions: Filing of Regulation 31(4) disclosure within 2 trading days of crossing threshold
approvals: SEBI Takeover Code compliance review (NSE monitoring)
Possible Section 4 mandatory offer obligation if shareholding breach triggers it

triggers.note: Disclosure filed upon crossing defined shareholding threshold; initiates public notification phase.
If aggregate holding now meets or exceeds 25%, mandatory open offer to all shareholders is likely triggered unless exempted.
Exchange notification and public announcement of material change in control or substantial shareholding.
